_comment: THE single source of truth for off-grid scenery transforms (Docs/Rim.md B2). Units: METERS and unitless mesh scale — the glTF importer already converts Blender meters to UE centimeters (every street tile proves it: scale 1.0, perfect 10 m hexes), so consumers apply NO extra unit factor to scale. setup_scenery.py converts positions m->uu (x100) for actor locations; render_eyeline.py uses meters directly. Born of the 2026-06-12 units bug: a duplicated table let the eyeline gate validate scale 1.0-2.7 while the editor shipped x100.
